# ADR-3075: A07: Session fixation accept for auth flow 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Reusing pre-login session IDs enables fixation.

## Decision

Auth flows MUST NOT perform a session fixation accept for auth flow 3 (A07-3).

## Consequences

Rotate session identifiers on authentication.
